early_warning.name: Aggregate early warning profile pending county adoption
early_warning.algorithm_note: No single national aggregate early-warning score is asserted for Kenya. The transportable NEWS2 bands are carried as a candidate so the mechanism is testable; the county or facility must load its adopted parameter table before clinical use.

2.label: Scale 2 - prescribed target range 88-92% in hypercapnic respiratory failure

safe_staffing.roster_authority_note: Nursing Station consumes the roster through the BulletTrain hub and never authors it (NFR-NS-028). County human-resource systems remain the establishment authority.

declaration_policy.authority_note: A shortage declaration is a named human act. Nursing Station never declares automatically; it computes the position and presents it for decision (NFR-NS-030).

declaration_contract.model_note: The governed role-assumption model has no shortage severity, no role enum and no approval field. A declaration is active or it is not.

harm_incident.pressure_injury_classification: EPUAP/NPIAP category I-IV, unstageable, deep tissue injury

external_reporting.receiver_authority: Ministry of Health, Republic of Kenya
external_reporting.owner_note: Nursing Station records and reviews the ward incident and publishes it through the hub. It is not the national incident registry.

criteria.title: Discharge medicines supplied and explained to the patient or carer
Required equipment and mobility aids confirmed available at the discharge address
Community health unit referral accepted by the receiving service
Condition, warning signs and escalation route explained and understood in the patient's language
Follow-up appointment issued to the patient

quality_measures.title: Registered nursing hours per patient day
quality_measures.numerator: registered nursing hours worked on the ward in the reporting period
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Registered nurse skill mix
quality_measures.numerator: registered nurse whole-time equivalents on duty
quality_measures.denominator: total nursing whole-time equivalents on duty

quality_measures.title: Missed nursing care rate
quality_measures.numerator: nursing tasks that reached their due time without completion or cancellation
quality_measures.denominator: nursing tasks due in the reporting period
exclusions: tasks cancelled before their due time

quality_measures.title: Falls with harm per 1000 occupied bed days
quality_measures.numerator: falls recorded with moderate or greater harm
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate (category 2 and above)
quality_measures.numerator: pressure injuries of category 2 or above that were not present on admission
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period
exclusions: injuries recorded as present on admission

quality_measures.title: Deterioration escalations answered within the required response interval
quality_measures.numerator: escalations with a recorded clinical response inside the profile response interval
quality_measures.denominator: escalations raised in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Medication administration omissions
quality_measures.denominator: medication occurrences with a recorded outcome
exclusions: occurrences recorded as delayed and later administered
